instruction: In apps/daemon/src/machine-loop.ts, when the Runner starts and runs recover(), stale local outbox journal entries in claimed or running state that are neither returned by client.recover() nor currently inFlight remain stuck in the journal (while awaiting-upload entries should be preserved). Also, sleepPrevention.sync() and its interval timer currently start before recover() finishes. Prune stale local claimed/running journal entries during recover() while keeping recovered, inFlight, and awaiting-upload entries, and start sleepPrevention sync/timer only after recover() completes.
